items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Zentralen Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland.
items.computation: This is a formally delivered document (Postzustellungsurkunde copy on page 2), so the delivery day is the date written on the envelope, not the +4-day fiction: 'zugestellt am 21.11.2026' (Saturday) is the delivery day, no days added (formal delivery rule). The two-week Einspruch period under §43 StPO/§187 Abs.1 BGB does not count the delivery day itself (21.11.2026); the period runs for two weeks (14 days) and ends on the same weekday two weeks later: 21.11.2026 (Sat) + 2 weeks = 05.12.2026 (Sat). Since the last day (05.12.2026) is a Saturday, under §43 Abs.2 StPO/§193 BGB the period moves to the next working day. 06.12.2026 is a Sunday (also non-working), so it moves further to Monday 07.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in Saarland. Final due date: 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay fine, fee and delivery costs (Gesamtbetrag) once the notice is final
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00.
items.computation: Payment is only due once the Bußgeldbescheid becomes 'rechtskräftig' (final), which happens if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period computed above, i.e. the notice becomes final at the end of 07.12.2026 (assuming no Einspruch is lodged). Taking 07.12.2026 as the triggering event (not counted itself), the two-week payment period (§187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.2 BGB) ends on the same weekday two weeks later: 07.12.2026 (Mon) + 2 weeks = 21.12.2026 (Mon), which is a normal working day in Saarland, so no further shift is needed. This date is conditional on no Einspruch being filed; if an Einspruch is lodged, this payment obligation does not arise on this schedule.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-12-21) is conditional: it only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-12-07 so that the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig); the letter itself does not state an exact finality date, so this date is a best estimate and may change if an objection is lodged.
